hadi-march/charts#BarList.name: BarList
hadi-march/charts#BarList.doc: Ranked horizontal bars with labels ("top N" lists). Rows are buttons when `onSelect` is set.
hadi-march/charts#BarList.tr: Etiketli, sıralı yatay çubuklar ("ilk N" listeleri). `onSelect` verilince satırlar düğme olur.

hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.name: heatLevel
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.doc: Level 0 (empty / ≤ 0) … levels-1 for a value relative to `max`.
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.signature: function heatLevel(v: number | null | undefined, max: number, levels: number = 5): number
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.tr: `max` değerine göre bir değerin seviyesi: 0 (boş / ≤ 0) … levels-1.

hadi-march/charts#Heatmap.name: Heatmap
hadi-march/charts#Heatmap.tr: Isı haritası. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#LineChart.name: LineChart
hadi-march/charts#LineChart.doc: Line chart. See docs/charts.md for props.
hadi-march/charts#LineChart.tr: Çizgi grafiği. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#lttb.name: lttb
hadi-march/charts#lttb.doc: Downsample a series to `threshold` points and keep its visual shape (Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets).
hadi-march/charts#lttb.signature: function lttb<T>(points: readonly T[], threshold: number, getX: (p: T) => number = (p) => coord(p, 0, "x"), getY: (p: T) => number = (p) => coord(p, 1, "y")): T[]

params.name: threshold
params.doc: wanted output length (≥ 3; smaller values return the input)

hadi-march/charts#lttb.tr: Bir seriyi görsel şeklini koruyarak `threshold` noktaya indirger (Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets).

hadi-march/charts#niceStep.name: niceStep
hadi-march/charts#niceStep.doc: A "nice" step (1, 2, 5 × 10^n) that splits `span` into about `count` parts.
hadi-march/charts#niceStep.signature: function niceStep(span: number, count: number = 5): number
hadi-march/charts#niceStep.tr: `span` aralığını yaklaşık `count` parçaya bölen "düzgün" bir adım (1, 2, 5 × 10^n).

hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.name: niceTicks
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.doc: Round a domain outwards to nice values. Returns `{ min, max, step, ticks }`.
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.signature: function niceTicks(min: number, max: number, count: number = 5): NiceTicks
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.tr: Bir tanım aralığını dışa doğru düzgün değerlere yuvarlar. `{ min, max, step, ticks }` döndürür.

hadi-march/charts#PieChart.name: PieChart
hadi-march/charts#PieChart.doc: Pie / donut chart. See docs/charts.md for props.
hadi-march/charts#PieChart.tr: Pasta / halka grafiği. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.name: pieLayout
hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.doc: Angles (radians, clockwise from 12 o'clock) for non-negative values. Returns [{start, end, value, share}].
hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.signature: function pieLayout(values: readonly unknown[], __1: { padAngle?: number } = {}): PieSlice[]
hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.tr: Negatif olmayan değerler için açılar (radyan, saat 12'den saat yönünde). [{start, end, value, share}] döndürür.

hadi-march/charts#ProgressRing.name: ProgressRing

props.name: colors
props.doc: Several colors: "brand" (the four HADİ colors, the HADİ theme's default), a list of color tokens, or "single" (one color even in a multicolor theme).

props.name: paint
props.doc: How several colors are laid out: "gradient" (default), "segments" (equal parts) or "cycle" (colors flow).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

hadi-march/charts#ProgressRing.tr: 0–100 (veya 0–`max`) puan halkası. `thresholds` (varsayılan [50, 80]) ile `m-ring-low|mid|high` seviye sınıfı verilir.

hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.name: scaleBand
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.doc: Band scale for categories. `s(v)` → band start; `s.bandwidth`; `s.step`; `s.center(v)`; `s.invert(px)` → nearest value.
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.signature: function scaleBand<V>(domain: readonly V[] = [], range: Range = [0, 1], __2: { paddingInner?: number; paddingOuter?: number } = {}): BandScale<V>
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.tr: Kategoriler için bant ölçeği. `s(v)` → bant başlangıcı; `s.bandwidth`; `s.step`; `s.center(v)`; `s.invert(px)` → en yakın değer.

hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.name: scaleLinear
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.doc: Linear scale. `s(v)` → range value; `s.invert(px)`; `s.ticks(n)`; `s.nice(n)` → new scale on a nice domain.
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.signature: function scaleLinear(domain: readonly [unknown, unknown] = [0, 1], range: Range = [0, 1]): LinearScale
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.tr: Doğrusal ölçek. `s(v)` → aralık değeri; `s.invert(px)`; `s.ticks(n)`; `s.nice(n)` → düzgün tanım aralığında yeni ölçek.

hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.name: scaleTime
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.doc: Time scale over Dates or epoch ms. `s.invert(px)` returns a Date.
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.signature: function scaleTime(domain: readonly [unknown, unknown], range: Range = [0, 1]): TimeScale
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.tr: Date veya epoch ms üzerinde zaman ölçeği. `s.invert(px)` bir Date döndürür.

hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.name: Sparkline
hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.doc: Tiny trend line without axes. `data` = numbers or objects (`y` key/fn).
hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.tr: Eksensiz küçük eğilim çizgisi. `data` = sayılar veya nesneler (`y` anahtarı/işlevi).

hadi-march/charts#Stat.name: Stat
hadi-march/charts#Stat.doc: KPI box: label, formatted value, delta (fraction by default: 0.12 → "+12%") with an arrow, optional sparkline. `previous` computes the delta; `invert` marks a decrease as good (e.g. costs); `deltaFormat` formats |delta|.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (hadi-march/icons) shown next to the label.

hadi-march/charts#Stat.tr: KPI kutusu: etiket, biçimlendirilmiş değer, oklu fark (varsayılan olarak kesir: 0.12 → "+12%"), isteğe bağlı sparkline. `previous` farkı hesaplar; `invert` düşüşü iyi sayar (ör. maliyet); `deltaFormat` |fark| değerini biçimlendirir.

hadi-march/charts#timeTicks.name: timeTicks
hadi-march/charts#timeTicks.doc: Tick values (epoch ms) on calendar boundaries: seconds … days, weeks, months, quarters, years.
hadi-march/charts#timeTicks.signature: function timeTicks(start: number | Date, stop: number | Date, count: number = 6): number[]
hadi-march/charts#timeTicks.tr: Takvim sınırlarında işaret değerleri (epoch ms): saniye … gün, hafta, ay, çeyrek, yıl.

hadi-march/crud#crud.name: crud
hadi-march/crud#crud.doc: A full list + form screen from a schema and a data source: table, search, create, edit, delete, permissions.
hadi-march/crud#crud.signature: function crud<R extends Row = Row>(source: CrudSource<R>, opts: CrudOptions<R>): unknown
hadi-march/crud#crud.tr: Şema ve veri kaynağından tam bir liste + form ekranı: tablo, arama, oluşturma, düzenleme, silme, izinler.

hadi-march/lazy#chunksOf.name: chunksOf
hadi-march/lazy#chunksOf.doc: Files of a dynamic import (source key) according to the build manifest, or null when unknown.
hadi-march/lazy#chunksOf.signature: function chunksOf(key: string): readonly string[] | null
hadi-march/lazy#chunksOf.tr: Derleme manifestine göre bir dinamik import'un (kaynak anahtarı) dosyaları, bilinmiyorsa null.

hadi-march/lazy#lazy.name: lazy
hadi-march/lazy#lazy.doc: `const Map = lazy(() => import("./Map.tsx"), { when: "visible", placeholder: "card", height: "20rem" })` then `<Map … />`. `Map.preload()` warms it up (hover, idle). Later renders are synchronous (no skeleton).
hadi-march/lazy#lazy.signature:
function lazy

>(load: () => Promise>, opts: LazyOptions

= {}): LazyComponent
hadi-march/lazy#lazy.tr: `const Map = lazy(() => import("./Map.tsx"), { when: "visible", placeholder: "card", height: "20rem" })` sonra `<Map … />`. `Map.preload()` onu ısıtır (üzerine gelme, boşta). Sonraki çizimler eşzamanlıdır (iskelet yok).

hadi-march/lazy#loaderKey.name: loaderKey
hadi-march/lazy#loaderKey.doc: The manifest key the compiler attached to a loader (`() => import("./x.tsx")`), if any.
hadi-march/lazy#loaderKey.tr: Derleyicinin bir yükleyiciye (`() => import("./x.tsx")`) eklediği manifest anahtarı, varsa.

hadi-march/lazy#prefetchCommon.name: prefetchCommon
hadi-march/lazy#prefetchCommon.doc: Prefetch (lowest priority) the shared "common" chunk(s) `march build` makes from small code many pages use (manifest key "march:common"); the router calls it when idle after the first page. Skipped when the user saves data.
hadi-march/lazy#prefetchCommon.tr: `march build`in çok sayıda sayfanın kullandığı küçük koddan ürettiği ortak parçaları (manifest anahtarı "march:common") en düşük öncelikle önceden getirir; yönlendirici ilk sayfadan sonra boştayken çağırır. Kullanıcı veri tasarrufu istediğinde atlanır.

hadi-march/lazy#preloadChunks.name: preloadChunks
hadi-march/lazy#preloadChunks.doc: Preload every chunk a dynamic import needs (by its manifest key). Returns false when the key is unknown.
hadi-march/lazy#preloadChunks.signature: function preloadChunks(key: string | undefined | null, low: boolean = false): boolean
hadi-march/lazy#preloadChunks.tr: Bir dinamik import'un ihtiyaç duyduğu tüm parçaları (manifest anahtarıyla) önceden yükler. Anahtar bilinmiyorsa false döndürür.

hadi-march/lazy#preloadFiles.name: preloadFiles
hadi-march/lazy#preloadFiles.doc: Add <link rel="modulepreload"> (JS) / <link rel="preload" as="style"> (CSS) for each file once. `low` (idle, speculative) uses <link rel="prefetch"> instead: lowest priority, never competes with what the page needs now.
hadi-march/lazy#preloadFiles.signature: function preloadFiles(files: readonly string[], low: boolean = false): void
hadi-march/lazy#preloadFiles.tr: Her dosya için bir kez <link rel="modulepreload"> (JS) / <link rel="preload" as="style"> (CSS) ekler. `low` (boşta, tahmini) bunun yerine <link rel="prefetch"> kullanır: en düşük öncelik, sayfanın şimdi ihtiyaç duyduklarıyla yarışmaz.

hadi-march/lazy#runLoad.name: runLoad
hadi-march/lazy#runLoad.doc: Load a route or lazy part: preload its files, honour the demo delay, then run it (through the load runner).
hadi-march/lazy#runLoad.signature: function runLoad<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, info: LoadInfo): Promise<T>
hadi-march/lazy#runLoad.tr: Bir rotayı veya tembel parçayı yükler: dosyalarını önceden yükler, demo gecikmesine uyar, sonra (yük çalıştırıcısı üzerinden) çalıştırır.

hadi-march/lazy#saveData.name: saveData
hadi-march/lazy#saveData.doc: True when the user asked to save data or the connection is 2G-class: skip speculative downloads.
hadi-march/lazy#saveData.tr: Kullanıcı veri tasarrufu istediyse veya bağlantı 2G sınıfındaysa true: tahmini indirmeler atlanır.

hadi-march/lazy#setLoadDelay.name: setLoadDelay
hadi-march/lazy#setLoadDelay.doc: Demo / testing: add an artificial delay (ms) before every lazy component and route chunk loads ("slow 3G").
hadi-march/lazy#setLoadDelay.tr: Demo / test: her tembel bileşen ve rota parçası yüklenmeden önce yapay gecikme (ms) ekler ("yavaş 3G").

hadi-march/lazy#setLoadRunner.name: setLoadRunner
hadi-march/lazy#setLoadRunner.doc: Route and lazy() chunk loads go through `r` (hadi-march/net installs itself when it is imported).
hadi-march/lazy#setLoadRunner.tr: Rota ve lazy() parça yüklemeleri `r` üzerinden geçer (hadi-march/net içe aktarılınca kendini kurar).

hadi-march/lazy#setPreloadManifest.name: setPreloadManifest
hadi-march/lazy#setPreloadManifest.signature: function setPreloadManifest(m: Manifest | null, base?: string): void
hadi-march/lazy#setPreloadManifest.tr: Başka bir manifest kullanır (testler, özel sunucular).

hadi-march/lazy#skeleton.name: skeleton
hadi-march/lazy#skeleton.doc: A skeleton of a given kind: one element, the shape (lines, rows, bars, fields) is drawn by CSS (lazy.css).
hadi-march/lazy#skeleton.tr: Verilen türde bir iskelet: tek öğe; şekli (satırlar, sıralar, çubuklar, alanlar) CSS çizer (lazy.css).

hadi-march/lazy#whenIdle.name: whenIdle
hadi-march/lazy#whenIdle.doc: Run `fn` when the browser is idle (setTimeout fallback). Returns a cancel function.
hadi-march/lazy#whenIdle.signature: function whenIdle(fn: () => void, timeout: number = 2000): () => void
hadi-march/lazy#whenIdle.tr: Tarayıcı boştayken `fn` işlevini çalıştırır (setTimeout yedekli). İptal işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/sw#applyUpdate.name: applyUpdate
hadi-march/sw#applyUpdate.doc: Activate the waiting version and reload the page once it takes over.
hadi-march/sw#applyUpdate.tr: Bekleyen sürümü etkinleştirir ve devralınca sayfayı yeniden yükler.

hadi-march/sw#registerServiceWorker.name: registerServiceWorker
hadi-march/sw#registerServiceWorker.doc: Register the worker (no-op where unsupported, e.g. file:// or old browsers). Resolves the registration or null.
hadi-march/sw#registerServiceWorker.tr: Çalışanı kaydeder (desteklenmeyen yerlerde, ör. file:// veya eski tarayıcılarda işlem yapmaz). Kaydı veya null döndürür.

hadi-march/sw#unregisterServiceWorker.name: unregisterServiceWorker
hadi-march/sw#unregisterServiceWorker.doc: Remove the worker and its caches (settings › "clear offline data").
hadi-march/sw#unregisterServiceWorker.tr: Çalışanı ve önbelleklerini kaldırır (ayarlar › "çevrimdışı verileri temizle").

hadi-march/motion#animate.name: animate
hadi-march/motion#animate.doc: Animate an element (or any engine target). Returns a Playback; `finished` resolves when done or cancelled.
hadi-march/motion#animate.signature: function animate(el: Element, frames: Frames | string, opts: AnimateOptions & EngineOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#animate.tr: Bir öğeyi (veya herhangi bir motor hedefini) canlandırır. Bir Playback döndürür; `finished` bitince veya iptal edilince çözülür.

hadi-march/motion#animateEl.name: animateEl
hadi-march/motion#animateEl.doc: A raw WAAPI animation for a component that needs the Animation object (marquee, a small pop): it follows the global speed, "pause all" and reduced motion like every engine animation. Null where WAAPI is missing. Prefer animate().
hadi-march/motion#animateEl.signature: function animateEl(el: Element, frames: Keyframe[] | PropertyIndexedKeyframes, opts: KeyframeAnimationOptions): Animation | null
hadi-march/motion#animateEl.tr: Animation nesnesine ihtiyaç duyan bir bileşen (marquee, küçük bir pop) için ham WAAPI animasyonu: her motor animasyonu gibi genel hızı, "tümünü duraklat" ve azaltılmış hareketi izler. WAAPI yoksa null.

hadi-march/motion#animateList.name: animateList
hadi-march/motion#animateList.doc: Animate the children of `container` as they are added, removed and reordered. Returns a function that stops.
hadi-march/motion#animateList.signature: function animateList(container: HTMLElement, o: ListOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#animateList.tr: `container` alt öğelerini eklenip çıkarıldıkça ve yeniden sıralandıkça canlandırır. Durduran bir işlev döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#animateValue.name: animateValue
hadi-march/motion#animateValue.doc: Play one value from → to; `onUpdate(value)` every frame. Arrays are filled in place (no allocation).
hadi-march/motion#animateValue.signature: function animateValue<T extends Animatable>(from: T, to: T, opts: AnimateOptions & { onUpdate?: (v: T) => void } = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#animateValue.tr: Bir değeri from → to oynatır; her karede `onUpdate(value)` çağrılır. Diziler yerinde doldurulur (ayırma yok).

hadi-march/motion#blinds.name: blinds

hadi-march/motion#bounceEase.name: bounceEase
hadi-march/motion#bounceEase.doc: A bouncing landing (like a ball): `bounces` hops, each `decay` as high as the previous.
hadi-march/motion#bounceEase.signature: function bounceEase(bounces: number = 3, decay: number = 0.35): Ease
hadi-march/motion#bounceEase.tr: Zıplayarak iniş (top gibi): `bounces` sekme, her biri öncekinin `decay` katı yükseklikte.

hadi-march/motion#canvas2d.name: canvas2d
hadi-march/motion#canvas2d.doc: A 2D canvas as an animation target: `draw(state, ctx)` runs once per frame while its state animates.
hadi-march/motion#canvas2d.signature: function canvas2d<S extends object>(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas | Ctx2D, draw: (state: S, ctx: Ctx2D) => void, state: S): Canvas2DTarget<S>
hadi-march/motion#canvas2d.tr: Animasyon hedefi olarak 2D canvas: durumu canlanırken `draw(state, ctx)` karede bir kez çalışır.

hadi-march/motion#circle.name: circle
hadi-march/motion#circle.doc: The new page opens as a circle from the pressed point (back: the old one closes into it).
hadi-march/motion#circle.tr: Yeni sayfa basılan noktadan daire olarak açılır (geri: eski sayfa içine kapanır).

hadi-march/motion#clipAt.name: clipAt
hadi-march/motion#clipAt.doc: The clip-path of a reveal at `p` (0 hidden … 1 shown).
hadi-march/motion#clipAt.signature: function clipAt(p: number, o: ClipOptions = {}): string
hadi-march/motion#clipAt.tr: `p` anındaki bir açılışın clip-path değeri (0 gizli … 1 görünür).

hadi-march/motion#clipFrames.name: clipFrames
hadi-march/motion#clipFrames.doc: Keyframes for a reveal (or a hide). Blinds and circles stay the same shape, so the browser interpolates them.
hadi-march/motion#clipFrames.signature: function clipFrames(o: ClipOptions & { hide?: boolean } = {}): Keyframe[]
hadi-march/motion#clipFrames.tr: Bir açılış (veya gizleme) için anahtar kareler. Jaluzi ve daireler aynı şekilde kaldığından tarayıcı aradeğerleme yapar.

hadi-march/motion#clipReveal.name: clipReveal
hadi-march/motion#clipReveal.doc: Reveal (or with `hide: true` hide) an element through a clip-path shape.
hadi-march/motion#clipReveal.signature: function clipReveal(el: Element, o: ClipOptions & AnimateOptions & { hide?: boolean } = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#clipReveal.tr: Bir öğeyi clip-path şekliyle gösterir (`hide: true` ile gizler).

hadi-march/motion#COMPOSITOR.name: COMPOSITOR
hadi-march/motion#COMPOSITOR.doc: Properties the compositor animates without layout or paint.
hadi-march/motion#COMPOSITOR.tr: Bileşimleyicinin yerleşim veya boyama olmadan canlandırdığı özellikler.

hadi-march/motion#cssAnimations.name: cssAnimations
hadi-march/motion#cssAnimations.doc: Control the CSS animations and transitions under `root` (default: the whole document).
hadi-march/motion#cssAnimations.tr: `root` altındaki (varsayılan: tüm belge) CSS animasyonlarını ve geçişlerini denetler.

hadi-march/motion#cssVars.name: cssVars
hadi-march/motion#cssVars.doc: Animate CSS custom properties of an element (registered with
hadi-march/motion#cssVars.signature: function cssVars(el: HTMLElement, vars: Record<string, string | { syntax: string; initial: string }> = {}): CssVarTarget

params.name: vars
params.type: Record<string, string | { syntax: string; initial: string }>

hadi-march/motion#cssVars.tr: Bir öğenin CSS özel özelliklerini canlandırır (aradeğerlenmeleri için @property ile kaydedilir).

hadi-march/motion#cube.name: cube
hadi-march/motion#cube.doc: A cube turns: the two pages are neighbouring faces meeting at the moving edge.
hadi-march/motion#cube.tr: Küp döner: iki sayfa, hareket eden kenarda buluşan komşu yüzlerdir.

hadi-march/motion#curtain.name: curtain
hadi-march/motion#curtain.doc: Stage curtain: the new page opens from the middle out (back: the old one closes to the middle).
hadi-march/motion#curtain.value:
make("curtain", (side, dir) =>
  pair(side, dir, [{ clipPath: clipAt(0, { shape: "curtain" }) }, { clipPath: clipAt(1, { shape: "curtain" }) }]))
hadi-march/motion#curtain.tr: Sahne perdesi: yeni sayfa ortadan dışa açılır (geri: eski sayfa ortaya kapanır).

hadi-march/motion#defineDriver.name: defineDriver
hadi-march/motion#defineDriver.doc: Register a driver for a new kind of target. Later registrations win over earlier ones and over the built-ins.
hadi-march/motion#defineDriver.signature: function defineDriver<T>(name: string, spec: Omit<Driver<T>, "name">): Driver<T>
hadi-march/motion#defineDriver.tr: Yeni bir hedef türü için sürücü kaydeder. Sonraki kayıtlar öncekilere ve yerleşiklere üstün gelir.

hadi-march/motion#defineEasing.name: defineEasing
hadi-march/motion#defineEasing.doc: Register a named easing: a function, a CSS easing string, or an Ease. Themes and apps can add their own.
hadi-march/motion#defineEasing.signature: function defineEasing(name: string, def: EaseInput | (() => Ease)): void
hadi-march/motion#defineEasing.tr: Adlandırılmış bir yumuşatma kaydeder: işlev, CSS yumuşatma dizesi veya bir Ease. Temalar ve uygulamalar kendilerininkini ekleyebilir.

hadi-march/motion#defineMotion.name: defineMotion
hadi-march/motion#defineMotion.doc: Extend the engine: keyframes, easings, presets and characters, all usable by name everywhere.
hadi-march/motion#defineMotion.tr: Motoru genişletir: anahtar kareler, yumuşatmalar, ön ayarlar ve karakterler; hepsi her yerde adıyla kullanılır.

hadi-march/motion#definePageTransition.name: definePageTransition
hadi-march/motion#definePageTransition.doc: Add a transition type usable as `meta.transition` (e.g. the variants in hadi-march/motion page-fx).
hadi-march/motion#definePageTransition.signature: function definePageTransition(name: string, frames: PageTransitionFrames): void
hadi-march/motion#definePageTransition.tr: `meta.transition` olarak kullanılabilen bir geçiş türü ekler (ör. hadi-march/motion page-fx içindeki varyantlar).

hadi-march/motion#defineTransition.name: defineTransition
hadi-march/motion#defineTransition.doc: Define a custom transition: `defineTransition("pop", (o) => [{ transform: "scale(.5)" }, { transform: "none" }])`.
hadi-march/motion#defineTransition.signature: function defineTransition(name: string, make: Maker): void
hadi-march/motion#defineTransition.tr: Özel bir geçiş tanımlar: `defineTransition("pop", (o) => [{ transform: "scale(.5)" }, { transform: "none" }])`.

hadi-march/motion#displace.name: displace
hadi-march/motion#displace.doc: Distort through turbulence: the displacement scale animates `from` → `to` (water, heat, glitch-in).
hadi-march/motion#displace.signature: function displace(el: Element, o: DisplaceOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#displace.tr: Türbülans ile bozar: yer değiştirme ölçeği `from` → `to` canlanır (su, ısı, glitch-in).

hadi-march/motion#drag.name: drag
hadi-march/motion#drag.doc: Action: drag the element with the pointer (keyboard: arrow keys move by 10px when focused).
hadi-march/motion#drag.signature: function drag(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#drag.tr: Eylem: öğeyi işaretçiyle sürükler (klavye: odaktayken ok tuşları 10px kaydırır).

hadi-march/motion#drawDigits.name: drawDigits
hadi-march/motion#drawDigits.doc: Draw `text` into `box` without motion (first paint, reduced motion).
hadi-march/motion#drawDigits.signature: function drawDigits(box: HTMLElement, text: string): void
hadi-march/motion#drawDigits.tr: `text` değerini `box` içine hareketsiz çizer (ilk boyama, azaltılmış hareket).

hadi-march/motion#drawPath.name: drawPath
hadi-march/motion#drawPath.doc: Draw strokes in: works for path, line, polyline, polygon, circle, rect and ellipse.
hadi-march/motion#drawPath.signature: function drawPath(targets: Many, o: DrawOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#drawPath.tr: Çizgileri çizerek gösterir: path, line, polyline, polygon, circle, rect ve ellipse için çalışır.

hadi-march/motion#DRIVER.name: DRIVER
hadi-march/motion#DRIVER.doc: Targets can carry their own driver under this key (canvas2d(), webgl(), cssVars() targets do).
hadi-march/motion#DRIVER.tr: Hedefler bu anahtar altında kendi sürücülerini taşıyabilir (canvas2d(), webgl(), cssVars() hedefleri taşır).

hadi-march/motion#driverFor.name: driverFor
hadi-march/motion#driverFor.doc: The driver for a target: its own, then custom drivers, then dom, then object.
hadi-march/motion#driverFor.tr: Bir hedefin sürücüsü: önce kendisininki, sonra özel sürücüler, sonra dom, sonra object.

hadi-march/motion#ease.name: ease
hadi-march/motion#ease.doc: Resolve any easing input to an Ease (unknown names fall back to `fallback`).
hadi-march/motion#ease.signature: function ease(input: EaseInput | null | undefined, fallback: EaseInput = "out"): Ease
hadi-march/motion#ease.tr: Herhangi bir yumuşatma girdisini Ease'e çözer (bilinmeyen adlar `fallback` değerine döner).

hadi-march/motion#easingNames.name: easingNames
hadi-march/motion#easingNames.doc: Names of every registered easing (for pickers).

hadi-march/motion#Effect.name: Effect
hadi-march/motion#Effect.doc: One target × its tracks with timing: the unit both paths play.

ctor.text: new Effect(target: unknown, frames: Frames, t: Timing, forceJs: boolean): Effect

members.name: driver
members.summary: The driver that reads and writes the animated target.

members.name: raw
members.summary: The normalized keyframe tracks before they are compiled.

members.name: props
members.summary: The names of the properties this effect animates.

members.name: delay
members.summary: Milliseconds to wait before the effect starts.

members.name: duration
members.summary: Milliseconds one iteration takes.

members.name: iterations
members.summary: How many times the effect repeats (Infinity for endless).

members.name: endDelay
members.summary: Milliseconds to hold after the last iteration before the effect ends.

members.name: direction
members.summary: Whether iterations play forward, backward or alternate.

members.name: fill
members.summary: Which values the effect keeps applying before it starts and after it ends.

members.name: ease
members.summary: The easing applied to each iteration's progress.

members.name: start
members.summary: Absolute start inside the root playback (set when the root collects its effects).

members.name: native
members.summary: The native browser animation, once created.

members.name: tracks
members.summary: The compiled JS tracks, once created.

members.name: useNative
members.summary: True when the effect runs as a native animation instead of the JS path.

members.name: target
members.summary: The object being animated (an element, canvas, or other driver target).

members.name: end
members.summary: Local end (delay + active + endDelay); Infinity for endless effects.

members.name: ensureNative
members.summary: Create the native animation (paused) once; null when the driver refuses (then the JS path takes over).

members.name: liveRoot
members.summary: The running root playback this effect belongs to, if any.

members.name: ensureTracks
members.summary: Compile the JS tracks (reads implicit start / end values from the target).

members.name: progressAt
members.summary: Iteration progress (eased) at local time t, or null when the effect has no effect then (fill).

members.name: sample
members.summary: JS path: sample and write at local time t (skipped while the target is off screen).

members.name: restore
members.summary: Puts the animated properties back to their original values.

members.name: watch
members.summary: Starts or stops pausing the effect while its target is off screen.

members.name: dispose
members.summary: Cancels the native animation and stops watching the target.

hadi-march/motion#Effect.tr: Zamanlamalı bir hedef × izleri: iki yolun da oynattığı birim.

hadi-march/motion#filterBlur.name: filterBlur
hadi-march/motion#filterBlur.doc: Blur in or out through an SVG Gaussian blur (one axis for a motion blur).
hadi-march/motion#filterBlur.signature: function filterBlur(el: Element, o: BlurOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#filterBlur.tr: SVG Gauss bulanıklığıyla bulanıklaşarak girer veya çıkar (hareket bulanıklığı için tek eksen).

hadi-march/motion#flatten.name: flatten
hadi-march/motion#flatten.doc: Flatten into polylines (one per subpath); curves become `steps` segments each.
hadi-march/motion#flatten.signature: function flatten(d: string, steps: number = 16): Poly[]
hadi-march/motion#flatten.tr: Çoklu çizgilere düzleştirir (alt yol başına bir); eğriler her biri `steps` parçaya bölünür.

hadi-march/motion#flip.name: flip
hadi-march/motion#flip.doc: FLIP: measure elements, apply a DOM change, then animate them from their old place to the new one.
hadi-march/motion#flip.signature: function flip(elements: Element[], mutate: () => void, raw: unknown = {}): void
hadi-march/motion#flip.tr: FLIP: öğeleri ölçer, DOM değişikliğini uygular, sonra eski yerlerinden yenisine canlandırır.

hadi-march/motion#flipPage.name: flipPage
hadi-march/motion#flipPage.doc: A card flips over: the old page turns away, the new one is its back side.
hadi-march/motion#flipPage.tr: Kart çevrilir: eski sayfa döner, yenisi onun arka yüzüdür.

hadi-march/motion#followPath.name: followPath
hadi-march/motion#followPath.doc: Move an element along a path (a `d` string or a path element). SVG elements get a `transform` attribute in user units; HTML elements a CSS transform in px (draw the path in the element's offset parent coordinates).
hadi-march/motion#followPath.signature: function followPath(el: Element, path: string | Element, o: FollowOptions = {}): Playback
hadi-march/motion#followPath.tr: Bir öğeyi yol boyunca hareket ettirir (`d` dizesi veya path öğesi). SVG öğeleri kullanıcı birimlerinde `transform` özniteliği, HTML öğeleri px cinsinden CSS dönüşümü alır (yolu öğenin offset parent koordinatlarında çizin).

hadi-march/motion#frame.name: frame
hadi-march/motion#frame.doc: Run `fn(time)` on the next frame of the shared clock. Returns a cancel function.
hadi-march/motion#frame.tr: Ortak saatin sonraki karesinde `fn(time)` çalıştırır. İptal işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#frameLoop.name: frameLoop
hadi-march/motion#frameLoop.doc: Run `fn(dt)` every frame of the shared clock (dt in clock ms: scaled by the global speed; nothing runs while motion is paused). For canvas drawing loops in components: never a private requestAnimationFrame loop. Returns stop.
hadi-march/motion#frameLoop.tr: Ortak saatin her karesinde `fn(dt)` çalıştırır (dt saat ms cinsinden: genel hızla ölçeklenir; hareket duraklatılmışken hiçbir şey çalışmaz). Bileşenlerdeki canvas çizim döngüleri için: asla özel bir requestAnimationFrame döngüsü olmasın.

hadi-march/motion#frameMonitor.name: frameMonitor
hadi-march/motion#frameMonitor.doc: Frame rate monitor: fps, dropped frames and long tasks as signals.
hadi-march/motion#frameMonitor.tr: Kare hızı izleyici: fps, düşen kareler ve uzun görevler sinyal olarak.

hadi-march/motion#getKeyframes.name: getKeyframes
hadi-march/motion#getKeyframes.doc: Look up keyframes or a preset by name (presets resolve to their keyframes with merged timing).
hadi-march/motion#getKeyframes.tr: Anahtar kareleri veya ön ayarı adıyla bulur (ön ayarlar, birleştirilmiş zamanlamayla anahtar karelerine çözülür).

hadi-march/motion#goo.name: goo
hadi-march/motion#goo.doc: Gooey metaballs: the element's children melt together where they meet. Returns a function that removes it.
hadi-march/motion#goo.signature: function goo(el: Element, o: GooOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/motion#goo.tr: Yapışkan metaball'lar: öğenin çocukları buluştukları yerde erir. Kaldıran bir işlev döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#hoverParallax.name: hoverParallax
hadi-march/motion#hoverParallax.doc: Action: children marked `data-depth="0.2…1"` shift with the pointer (deeper ones more); the container may tilt.
hadi-march/motion#hoverParallax.signature: function hoverParallax(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#hoverParallax.tr: Eylem: `data-depth="0.2…1"` işaretli çocuklar işaretçiyle kayar (derindekiler daha çok); kapsayıcı eğilebilir.

hadi-march/motion#installFlip.name: installFlip
hadi-march/motion#installFlip.doc: Enable `<For animate>` reordering animations (FLIP on the motion engine).
hadi-march/motion#installFlip.tr: `<For animate>` yeniden sıralama animasyonlarını etkinleştirir (hareket motorunda FLIP).

hadi-march/motion#installPresets.name: installPresets
hadi-march/motion#installPresets.doc: Register the built-in keyframes (fadeUp, pop, shake, spin…) so they can be played by name.
hadi-march/motion#installPresets.tr: Yerleşik anahtar kareleri (fadeUp, pop, shake, spin…) adıyla oynatılabilmeleri için kaydeder.

hadi-march/motion#installThemeWave.name: installThemeWave
hadi-march/motion#installThemeWave.doc: From now on every page-wide restyle (setTheme, setColorTheme, setAccent — so ThemeMenu, ThemePicker, ThemeToggle, AccentPicker and your own calls) spreads from the point that was pressed last (a click, a tap, or the focused control for a key press). Returns a function that turns it off.
hadi-march/motion#installThemeWave.tr: Bundan sonra sayfa genelindeki her yeniden boyama (setTheme, setColorTheme, setAccent; yani ThemeMenu, ThemePicker, ThemeToggle, AccentPicker ve kendi çağrıların) son basılan noktadan yayılır. Kapatan işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/motion#installTransitions.name: installTransitions
hadi-march/motion#installTransitions.doc: Register the extra `transition:` names (blur, fly and the WAAPI fade/slide/scale).
hadi-march/motion#installTransitions.tr: Ek `transition:` adlarını kaydeder (blur, fly ve WAAPI fade/slide/scale).

hadi-march/motion#interpolatePath.name: interpolatePath
hadi-march/motion#interpolatePath.doc: A mixer between two paths: `mix(t)` → `d`. Same command list → numbers tween; otherwise both are resampled.
hadi-march/motion#interpolatePath.signature: function interpolatePath(from: string, to: string, o: { points?: number } = {}): (t: number) => string
hadi-march/motion#interpolatePath.tr: İki yol arasında karıştırıcı: `mix(t)` → `d`. Komut listesi aynıysa sayılar ara değerlenir; değilse ikisi de yeniden örneklenir.

hadi-march/motion#inView.name: inView
hadi-march/motion#inView.doc: Action: calls `enter` (and sets `className`, default "is-visible") when the element scrolls into view.
hadi-march/motion#inView.signature: function inView(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#inView.tr: Eylem: öğe görünüme kayınca `enter` işlevini çağırır (ve `className` ekler, varsayılan "is-visible").

hadi-march/motion#keyframeNames.name: keyframeNames
hadi-march/motion#keyframeNames.doc: Names of every registered keyframe preset.
hadi-march/motion#keyframeNames.tr: Kayıtlı tüm anahtar kare ön ayarlarının adları.

hadi-march/motion#keyframes.name: keyframes
hadi-march/motion#keyframes.doc: Register named keyframes with default timing. Returns the definition (usable directly with animate()).
hadi-march/motion#keyframes.signature: function keyframes(name: string, frames: Frames, defaults: Timing = {}): KeyframesDef
hadi-march/motion#keyframes.tr: Varsayılan zamanlamalı adlandırılmış anahtar kareleri kaydeder. Tanımı döndürür (doğrudan animate() ile kullanılabilir).

hadi-march/motion#keyframesCss.name: keyframesCss
hadi-march/motion#keyframesCss.doc: One CSS file from every registered keyframes (or `names`): `@keyframes m-<name>` and a `.m-anim-<name>` class with the default timing. Reduced motion (system or the user setting, `<html data-m-reduced>`) ends them at once. Easings without a CSS form (custom JS functions) fall back to the default curve.
hadi-march/motion#keyframesCss.signature: function keyframesCss(__0: { names?: string[]; prefix?: string } = {}): string
hadi-march/motion#keyframesCss.tr: Kayıtlı tüm anahtar karelerden (veya `names`) tek bir CSS dosyası: `@keyframes m-<name>` ve varsayılan zamanlamalı bir `.m-anim-<name>` sınıfı. Azaltılmış hareket (sistem veya kullanıcı ayarı, `<html data-m-reduced>`) bunları sonlandırır.

hadi-march/motion#listFrames.name: listFrames
hadi-march/motion#listFrames.doc: Keyframes of a preset (in or out); "slide" follows the text direction.
hadi-march/motion#listFrames.signature: function listFrames(preset: ListPreset, side: "in" | "out" = "in", rtl: boolean = false): Keyframe[]
hadi-march/motion#listFrames.tr: Bir hazır ayarın anahtar kareleri (giriş ya da çıkış); "slide" metin yönünü izler.

hadi-march/motion#magnet.name: magnet
hadi-march/motion#magnet.doc: Action: the element is pulled toward the pointer while hovered.
hadi-march/motion#magnet.signature: function magnet(el: Element, raw?: unknown): () => void
hadi-march/motion#magnet.tr: Eylem: üzerine gelinince öğe işaretçiye doğru çekilir.

hadi-march/motion#measure.name: measure
hadi-march/motion#measure.doc: Batch a DOM read into the next frame's read phase (before any write).
hadi-march/motion#measure.tr: Bir DOM okumasını sonraki karenin okuma aşamasına (yazmalardan önce) toplu ekler.
